text: Extremely dense breasts (ACR breast density d).

Biopsy-proven malignancy in the left breast at 1 o'clock, upper outer quadrant, 6 cm from the nipple, seen as a 2.2 x 1.8 cm irregular mass with spiculated margins containing the biopsy clip, BI-RADS 6.
1.2 cm group of fine pleomorphic calcifications in the left breast at 4 o'clock, lower outer quadrant, 3 cm from the nipple, separate from the index malignancy, BI-RADS 4C.
Right breast negative for malignancy, with no suspicious mass, calcifications or architectural distortion.
No enlarged axillary lymph nodes on either side.
